source_scope: Previous collector: all prior docs/matches/**/*.json outside this experiment, tests/data/*opening*.json, and the four sampled training/validation/QAT/precision JSONL datasets. Supplemental scan: all prior match JSON FEN fields and recorded final PVs, all prior docs/analysis/**/*.json FEN fields, and docs/analysis/**/queries.jsonl recorded query histories and final PVs. Final positions are compared by pieces-only identity including color/rank mirror. Intermediate UCI info-line PVs, PGN-only trajectories, and unsampled original training positions are outside this scan.
